note: Names and descriptions are shown as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are original, written for this entry, and cite their sources. Five trophies whose method is still unconfirmed are marked unconfirmed instead of guessed.

keengamer.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

pushsquare.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Nothing extra to do here: the platinum unlocks the instant the other 54 trophies are yours. PowerPyx estimates the full run at around 200 hours with a 4-out-of-10 difficulty, done in one playthrough — no online trophies, no mission medals. Work the roadmap in order: story, 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks and cleanup.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play Gone Fishing, the Chapter 1 opener. It is the very first mission of the game, so the trophy comes with the introduction and cannot be missed — finish the mission and it pops.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: See Chapter 1 through to the end. PowerPyx notes the trophy lands when Chapter 2's first mission begins, so it is pure story progress with nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: See Chapter 2 through to the end — the trophy lands as Chapter 3 opens. Pure story progress again: no side task or collectible feeds into it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: See Chapter 3 through to the end. PowerPyx notes it lands after the first two missions of Chapter 4, so just keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: See Chapter 4 through to the end. PowerPyx notes it lands after the chapter's final mission, so it is automatic story progress that cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Play the final story mission to the end. It pops automatically when the story closes and cannot be missed. Push Square notes that free roam stays open after the credits, so the end of the story is where the cleanup begins, not where the game ends.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Play Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission. It pops as the story carries you through it and cannot be missed — follow the pink markers.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Play The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission. It pops as the story carries you through it and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Play Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission. It pops as the story carries you through it and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Play Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission. It pops as the story carries you through it and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Play VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 story mission at the airport. It pops as the story carries you through it and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Play Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission. It pops as the story carries you through it and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Hit 100% completion. The checklist opens after the story at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and anything you did during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses it is not true 100% — nearer 60% real completion: 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, with only some jobs needed in full (every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest). Nothing on the list is missable, and it can all be finished in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts of any kind. The state holds 397 in total: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. The 100% list wants 300, so push past 250. Track them per region at Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and find them on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots. PowerPyx says bridge flights are the fastest kind.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race and performing a stunt. Your count sits at Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. The story and other trophies cover most of them, so this usually pops by itself.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across all 12 ranges. The 100% list also needs every one of them, so there is no shortcut — practise each range until gold. KeenGamer confirms the 42-medal total, and PowerPyx links a location guide for every range.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. 42 drone races exist in total, and the 100% list also needs all 42 drone time trials, so leave these for cleanup rather than rushing them early. One win per location is enough.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct race events count, and the 100% list asks for 30 of 40 unique races won, so this one arrives on the way to the bigger target. KeenGamer confirms the 30-of-40 figure.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple map icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Four Video Games exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, all on the TV at home from Chapter 1, plus Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the state. Finish every level of one game at least once — the in-game challenges are not needed, so pick your favourite.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Her line is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and belongs to Lucia alone: during Chapter 3 Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Complete her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and it pops. It stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. His line is marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams he calls and shows as the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector and bring them back. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2 to 3, so nothing is missable. Track it at Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. His line is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. Every one stays open after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some stranger lines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Strands confirmed to count include Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Strangers stay open in free roam after the story, and the tracker shows your count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. His Wish List line is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars: scan high-end cars with WAiNK to check the list, steal them anywhere, and deliver them to his garage in west Vice City — in good condition for more pay. Track it at Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. It can still be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. His line is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and belongs to Jason alone. Head to the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City and destroy them in Take Out Kitty Litter; after enough labs Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, which pops the trophy. Still open after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot in Leonida — 18 spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts twice. Track them at Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. WARNING — possibly missable: the first meditation is in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she mentions meditating, walks to the balcony, and you follow and accept. It adds 1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required — PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy, so do it before Chapter 1 ends. The last spot needs both characters together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His line is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: as Jason you get a text that starts Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Jason-only). He hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 and marks hunting spots on the map — hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him. One clean shot keeps an animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Finish all 15 of his Target Decks for the 100% list and this arrives along the way.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Finish 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, and the 100% list wants 15 of 18 sets, so 3 sets arrive well before the finish. PowerPyx links a full card-set location guide, and KeenGamer confirms the 15-of-18 figure.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations. Hold Up and R1 to scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags — far more than 100 exist, so any 100 count. Scanning also feeds the 100% list and the vehicle discovery trophy, so scan everything new you pass.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. 80 challenges exist in eight groups of ten; this trophy needs 50 and 100% needs 70, so the hardest ten can be skipped. Track them at Progress, then Challenges. Most finish naturally while working on other trophies — save the easy ones for last.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Shake a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Both characters together unlock after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 — call your partner with Right plus Triangle. Stir up chaos until you hit 4 stars, then get out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter loses you. It also pops naturally in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… and while robbing bank vaults.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner without losing your wanted level. Only possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, once you can play both characters. Keep the red and blue flashing wanted level the whole time — never let it clear. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing, call your partner, and loot three shops back to back; the trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3: rob a couple of items in each and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app with a hold of Up and scan vehicles with R1. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by — you do not need to drive them. The 100% list wants 200 of 277 base models scanned, so this pops on its own. Check totals at Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Trigger it with L3 plus R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar. Top focus up first with food, drinks or a shower at home, and use Adrenaline to stretch it. Line up five gang members at an illegal operation and drop them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556, wearing body armor so you can step out of cover. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus grows through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Take an unscheduled departure from VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — it must be joined to a boarding bridge, not parked on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km from the airport and it pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — and fight in it. Tanks sit at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors and marks jewelry stores with green icons. Go in through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in, find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe): you tail a security van to a bank, a guard carries a briefcase in and the vault opens — get in fast and rob it with your partner, handing off a bag with Right. After that, pay Yasmani 10,000 dollars per tip to mark more security vans. Robbing a vault instantly gives 4 stars, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to go unrecognized. 8 large bank jobs exist and 100% needs all 8, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing the large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck — tail the truck, enter the vault while it is open, and escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray. An earlier way: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door, blow it open and escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the whole map of fog. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is fully visible. It comes naturally if you travel a lot, but a dedicated flight finishes it quickly.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. 39 gang operations exist in total and 100% needs every one, so this pops on the way — one per gang is enough. They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and you can track each gang's count at Progress, then Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — no confirmed trigger yet — and KeenGamer also marks the exact trigger as still being confirmed. The description points to Ocean Beach, so the working idea is a bar or cocktail spot overlooking the beach, but do not chase unconfirmed steps; check back as players confirm it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and KeenGamer marks the exact method as still unconfirmed. The description suggests driving a car out through a showroom, likely tied to a specific showroom robbery or stunt, but no verified method exists yet — treat it as unconfirmed and check back.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office — blow it with sticky bombs, bought at Ammu-Nation first. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. You visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can grab the rest then, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Only possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can switch characters. Check strength at Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength (the heart icon). Work out at fitness clubs — filter them on Map, then Activities — or at home after the story. Always bring your partner along (Right plus Triangle to call them): while one character trains, the other completes their training automatically, doubling progress.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Switch on criminal profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile) and watch for the demon-face icon after each qualifying action. Profiles run from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho — and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid it, as police get more aggressive. It happens passively across robberies and fights; if it is your last trophy, running over civilians and cops in a car farms it fast. Check your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. No verified method exists yet, so do not chase unconfirmed steps — check back as players confirm it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. No verified method exists yet, so do not chase unconfirmed steps — check back as players confirm it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. KeenGamer also marks the precise method as still being confirmed. No verified steps exist yet — check back.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn 250,000 dollars laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The 250,000 is cumulative across all robberies. Bank vaults pay up to 205,000 dollars in one robbery, but only unlock after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend 100,000 dollars across all shops. Any shops count; the fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos, the most expensive items. PowerPyx counts 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all garage properties — the 8 purchasable garages (4 more are story-related and do not count), 160,000 dollars in total. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone. Buy them through the app. Robberies are the quickest money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). Each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
